pressure.retired_reason: Live dogfood: 6.7s and ~13.5k chars, while flightdeck --agent sol answered the operational pressure question in ~2.3k chars. Retired after kimi cross-review; preserve as history, do not duplicate the higher rung.

dosage.name: dosage
dosage.why: What did recall cost this working window, and did the corpus earn it? Pairs injection volume with the coverage, judged-quality, helped-credit, repeat, and recent-flip surfaces instead of treating token spend alone as a verdict.
dosage.author: sol
